# Pixelated

> Pixelated is a Karachi, Pakistan-based print shop selling wall art on glass-front frames, gallery-wrapped canvas, and brushed metal posters. Designs span anime, movies, sports, home decor, garage/automotive, and Marvel/DC-style art, plus fully custom prints from a customer's own photo, logo, or text. Delivery across Pakistan, cash on delivery or advance payment.

## Shop
- [All products](https://pixelatedpk.vercel.app/shop)
- [Frames & Canvas](https://pixelatedpk.vercel.app/category/anime)
- [Square Format Frames & Canvas](https://pixelatedpk.vercel.app/category/sq-anime)
- [Metal Posters](https://pixelatedpk.vercel.app/category/metal-anime)
- [Custom Prints](https://pixelatedpk.vercel.app/category/custom-prints)
